metric_estimate.description: A bounded metric in [0, 1] with an optional 95% confidence interval. The interval bounds are both present or both absent, and the value lies inside the interval; those cross-field rules are enforced by the Python validator (evidence.MetricEstimate), not by this schema.

operating_point.description: Declared operating point the metric was measured at (for example the builtin-heuristic native verdict). Null when the metric has no operating point.

description: One versioned validation-evidence record for a detector under a declared input regime (language x length x domain x editing x generator-vintage x human-population). Licence/consent and contamination_flag are registration-blocking: a record without either cannot be registered at any tier. Every other field is mandatory for 'supported' status; the Python validator caps the effective status at 'partial' when one is missing. Staleness is computed, never stored, so the signature stays valid when a record goes stale.

calibration_id.description: Link to the calibration artifact this record was measured under, or null when the detector emits no calibrated probability.

contamination_flag.description: Whether the detector was trained on the evaluation dataset. Missing at registration time is a hard error, not a cap.

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the dataset file or sample file the record was measured on.

licence.description: Dataset licence or consent basis. Missing or empty at registration time is a hard error, not a cap.

licence_reference.description: Where the licence/consent can be checked (URL, file path, or citation).

near_duplicate_method.description: How the near-duplicate rate was measured, or null when not measured (with the limitation recorded in limits.limitations).

near_duplicate_rate.description: Measured near-duplicate rate in [0, 1], or null when not measured.

row_hash_method.description: How per-row content hashes were computed (for example 'sha256 of normalised text (benchmark fingerprint)').

split.description: Dataset split the sample was drawn from.

split_role.description: Role this split played in the measurement: fit (threshold/calibration selection), threshold, or test (final evaluation).

appeal_note.description: What evidence would change this record (for example a larger human slice, or a re-measurement after a detector change).

demoted_by.description: Identifier of the process that demoted this record (U3 drift observatory hook); null until a demotion happens. A set value makes the effective status stale.

next_revalidation_due.description: ISO calendar date by which the record must be revalidated. Default: run_date + 90 days.

metrics.description: One entry per measured slice. worst_slice is true for the worst slice of the record; seed records have one slice each, so it is trivially true there. Multi-slice worst-slice reporting is a wave-2 concern.

coverage.description: Fraction of inputs in the slice that received a verdict (1 minus abstention rate).

fpr_native.description: Empirical human false-positive rate at the detector's native categorical operating point (no fitted score threshold).

tpr_native.description: Empirical true-positive rate at the detector's native categorical operating point — the pair of fpr_native; both are needed to read the operating point. Optional in v1 (records predating it omit the key).

record_id.description: Stable, human-meaningful identifier (evr-YYYYMMDD-<dataset>-builtin-heuristic). Content-addressing is provided by signature, not by the id.

attack_slice.description: Attack/adversarial slice this record covers, or null when the record covers the unattacked regime.

editing_regime.description: Research vocabulary for the editing regime this record covers.

current_as_of.description: ISO calendar date the generator vintage statement was current as of.

determined_how.description: How the human population was determined (for example dataset documentation).

language.description: BCP 47 language tag of the covered text (for example 'en').

language_variety.description: Language variety (for example a dialect or register), or null when not distinguished.

length_bucket.description: Length bucket the record covers. floor_words is the minimum word count the record's evidence speaks to; measured_* are the observed word-count statistics of the measured sample (whitespace word count).

script.description: ISO 15924 script code of the covered text (for example 'Latn').

code_version.description: Full git SHA (40 hex) of the repo HEAD at run time, or an abbreviated SHA of at least 7 hex characters.

command.description: The exact command that produced this run.

dependency_lock_sha.description: SHA-256 of the dependency lock / environment at run time, or null when no lock was captured.

drops_manifest.description: Everything the run excluded, each with a reason. The key must be present; an empty list means nothing was dropped.

reporting_rules.description: Reporting rules applied to this run (for example which slices are reported and how abstentions are counted).

run_artifact.description: Repo-relative path of the U7 run-artifact file this record's measurements come from.

run_artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the run-artifact file at record time.

run_date.description: ISO calendar date of the run.

runtime.description: Runtime the run executed under (for example 'CPython 3.12.3 on Linux').

seeds.description: Random seeds used by the run (bootstrap seed is mandatory).

signature.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of the record excluding the signature field itself.

status.description: Stored status. The effective status is computed by the validator (partial cap, staleness) and may differ; the stored record never changes when it goes stale.

supersedes.description: record_id of the record this one supersedes, or null.

title: TextForensics validation evidence record (U1)
